name: tend
summary: Loops and evals for agents, self-briefing pages for humans; a pass only a verifier can write.

flagged.why: @plotplot/tend is not published yet; the publish is owner-run. Until it lands the umbrella pins this bed by install.git.rev (jahala/plotplot 60). That rev names the master this manifest was planted on, so every landing leaves it one behind; the pin is the umbrella's to move.

the plugin carries eight skills under plugin/skills/*/SKILL.md; the manifest names the router (next), the one a session reads first. The umbrella's tend loop decided on 2026-09-05 to fold the eight into one SKILL.md and cut the MCP surface to three pens; neither has landed, so the cost below is the eight descriptions plus six tool schemas as they stand.

measured as every skill description plus the tools/list schemas at four characters per token (test/garden-manifest.test.ts recomputes it). The SessionStart hook injects more on top, about 1,300 tokens on tend's own 42-loop map on 2026-09-16, and is not counted here; its 300-token cap is an open check on the umbrella's tend loop.

tend's gate judges loop pages, not diffs: `tend lint --format sarif <map>` emits one SARIF log with a result per finding, and on a repository with no map it emits an empty envelope. The umbrella's F2 fixture (a staged test deletion) is weeder's shape; tend's fixture needs a map with a malformed page.
